lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with approximately five primary horizontal tracks visible.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct high-luminance nodes at the intersection points across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal-facing surface to a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance circular spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, scattered irregularly across the medial surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin displays a high-contrast pattern of white spots against a darker background on both the upper and lower lobes; similar high-intensity spotting is present on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
